decisions.reason: The production paragraph left its finite certificate inequalities unspecified and did not restrict the displayed ratio to positive prior mass. This is an interface omission rather than a false VTAA bound: the consuming VTAA theorem already states positive success and exactly these inequalities. The Definition now supplies initialization, positive masses, surviving floor, loss inequality and final rational enclosure explicitly; finite certificate acquisition remains charged.

The Definition explicitly includes the QLSP state-output data of def-qa-26-qlsp-task. That supplier requires the support gap to be supplied rationally or exactly represented, so this data requirement is inherited; the later prose does not revoke it. The block-encoding supplier also explicitly requires alpha at least the operator norm, even for approximate encodings. On the supported left singular space the target (gamma/2)A+ has the correct domain and nonzero normalization. No repair is needed.

The frozen lemma permits distinct ancilla widths but forms a sum of component unitaries without specifying common-register extensions. Confirmed a typing gap in its stated SELECT identity. Set a=max a_j and use I tensor U_j on the common register, preserving each zero block; weighted compression is then exactly sum beta_j A_j/Lambda. The current access supplier independently specifies this convention, but its guard has changed since the frozen pack; the lemma now states the extension explicitly. CKS already embeds all component work in one common register.

The rejection confuses adjoint and pseudoinverse. The track defines M dagger as conjugate transpose (def-qc-dirac-notation-conversion and def-qa-22-block-encoding); its pseudoinverse is M+. If bar A=sum sigma_j |u_j><v_j|, then pSV(bar A dagger)=sum p(sigma_j)|v_j><u_j|, approximating (delta/2)bar A+ with error at most e on supported left singular vectors. No reciprocal singular value is fed to p. The algorithm explicitly swaps the projectors and executes the adjoint encoding. Checked the local OP1A reciprocal truncation, erf interpolation, even cutoff and certificate-margin argument; they do not change this orientation.

The admitted rho need not have an encoding or be rational, but rho/(16n) is passed to an estimator requiring rational beta. This violates a called dependency interface. The input now specifies rational rho. Also confirmed the Step-4 decoded-support counterexample and unrestricted-precision resource defect: require decoded support within the location lists and fix eta_I, dyadic zeta=eta_S, scalar stage errors, simulator tolerances and slot tolerances, retaining all access and construction costs. Least admissible scales/degrees at these tolerances have logarithmic precision length. The common-register LCU supplier is satisfied by the Fourier mode explicit idle-wire embeddings.

The proof uses one-based intervals but initializes index minus one, leaving r_0 and s_0 undefined at its first recurrence. Set r_0=s_0=1 at the prepared all-unfinished state; then q_1=s_1>=p and the induction floor follows. Rechecked q_i>=p/(16n)>=1/(64n alpha^2)>p_min, both estimate branches and the final 1/(18n) floor. The decoded support promise now justifies the exact sparse compression. The RMS perturbation is bounded with one stopping-time-squared observable, and residual internal-work error remains covered by the final projection. The Statement is unchanged.
